designRules: The production matrix must keep all ten production phases plus the final launch phase visible as 55 checkable subphases.
Openlands Standard remains relaxed; blocked runtime work must not be reclassified as complete.
Every checkpoint must list concrete module, edition, artifact, or runtime-gate evidence.

launchRoadmapDefaultRule: Openlands Standard remains the relaxed default through MVP, Public Alpha, 1.0, and later updates.
